settings.title: Set the stage
settings.personaStyleHint: How much the persona may bend move choice inside the near-best candidate pool. Subtle keeps strength almost unchanged.
settings.personaHint: Changes voice and a bounded near-best move style — combine it with any difficulty.
settings.agentLanguageHint: The AI may write better in a different language than the UI.
settings.piecesHint: Add a folder under ~/.local/share/gambiit/pieces/ with files named wK.svg, wQ.svg … bP.svg. PNG and WebP work too; missing pieces fall back to the built-in set.
settings.piecesMissing: This piece set is missing; the built-in set is used instead.
settings.chooseModelFirst: Choose or type a model above to load provider credentials.
settings.agentModeMcpHint: The model queries tools over local MCP
settings.agentModeHint: MCP lets the model read the board and submit its move through tools. It can be slower than prompt mode, which remains the safe fallback.
settings.engineNote: Difficulty sets the Stockfish candidate pool; the persona colours the voice and may reorder near-best candidates inside the chosen style tolerance. Stockfish proposes the candidates, the model chooses one, and may still bluff about the evaluation. The board stays authoritative.
settings.gameWarning: Model, persona, difficulty, agent language or connection mode changes affect the current opponent from the next move. You can keep playing, or save and start a new game.
settings.colorWarning: Changing colour requires a new game. Saving will start it now.
settings.localProvider: Local provider — no API key needed.
settings.keySavedPlaceholder: Saved — paste a new key to replace
settings.credentialsHint: Stored locally with 0600 permissions. Leave empty to use OpenCode's own authentication. Applied when you start a game.
settings.opencodeAuthHint: OpenCode Go and GitHub Copilot may use the desktop app's own login; a custom key may not override it.
settings.featuresHint: Both can be turned off at any time. Existing chat is kept.
settings.clockNote: Clocks start with the first move. The opponent's thinking time counts against its own clock. Clock changes apply to a new game.
settings.clockWarning: Clock settings apply to a new game.

chat.emptyBody: Your opponent can talk, bluff and needle you. The board stays the truth.
chat.suggestion1: How do you feel about the position?
chat.hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a new line

personas.theaterMasterDescription: Dramatic, confident, fond of psychological pressure.
personas.panickerDescription: Anxious and emotional, but the analysis stays sharp.
personas.chaoticDescription: Unpredictable and funny, but still legal.
personas.customDescription: Your own mix of voice and style.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.description: Weak engine, wide candidate pool. Depth 5, top 6, skill 0.

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Balanced club play. Depth 11, top 4, skill 10.

master.name: Master
master.description: Full engine strength. Depth 19, top 2, skill 20.

custom.name: Custom
custom.description: Tune depth and candidate count yourself. Skill 20.

games.title: Games
games.exportHint: The PGN includes tags, moves and comments.
games.importHint: Paste a standard PGN with SAN moves. Comments in braces are preserved.

analysis.title: Post-game analysis
analysis.hint: Stockfish reviews every move, rates accuracy and compares the agent's claims with the board.
analysis.emptyBody: Play a few moves, then return here. Analysis reads the whole game, including imported PGNs.
analysis.workingTitle: The engine is reading the game
analysis.workingBody: Checking {count} moves at depth {depth}. This can take a minute.
analysis.truthHint: These claims differ from the engine's evaluation by 1.50 or more.
analysis.truthCleanBody: Every evaluation the agent claimed matched the board closely enough.
analysis.claimWarning: The agent's claimed evaluation does not match what Stockfish sees on this board. Theater is allowed; the board is the truth.
analysis.footnote: Evaluations are from White's perspective. Best moves and losses come from the same Stockfish search.

leaderboard.title: Model leaderboard
leaderboard.hint: Results, speed and theater from your saved games. Only local games are counted.
leaderboard.recordHint: Wins / draws / losses from the opponent's side
leaderboard.emptyHint: Finish a game and it will appear here. Run post-game analysis to unlock accuracy and bluff rate.
leaderboard.footnote: Accuracy and bluff rate come from saved post-game analysis summaries. Win rate excludes unfinished games.

personaMixer.title: Build a custom opponent
personaMixer.hint: Mix the voice and bounded move style. The board and the rules never change.
personaMixer.name: Name
personaMixer.theatricalityHint: How dramatic and stage-aware the voice is.
personaMixer.confidenceHint: How certain and dominant the opponent sounds.
personaMixer.warmthHint: Friendly and respectful versus cold and distant.
personaMixer.aggressionHint: Sharp, attacking move preferences and tone.
personaMixer.deceptionHint: How readily the opponent exaggerates evaluations and plans.
personaMixer.styleNote: Traits affect voice and the bounded near-best move style. They never change rules, legality or the Stockfish candidate pool.
